name: Ansible AWX
description: Web UI, REST API and task engine for running and scheduling Ansible playbooks across an inventory.

envVars.description: Secret key used to encrypt credentials at rest

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://awx:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/awx"
      AWX_REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      AWX_ADMIN_PASSWORD: {{env.AWX_ADMIN_PASSWORD}}
      AWX_SECRET_KEY: {{env.AWX_SECRET_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/projects:/var/lib/awx/projects
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: awx
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: awx
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
